title: Replogle House, 305 West Main Street, Wabasha, Wabasha County, MN
notes: Significance: This building is located within the Wabash Commercial Historic District.  When the District nomination was prepared, this property was considered contributing because of its outbuilding (the Livery Stable which served as its garage).  However, this is the only building of its style and age located within a District which primarily consists of buildings constructed between 1856 and 1900.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 82003063
